what: Photos stacked in one cell switch to the next every 5 seconds. The incoming photo starts at 1.2× brightened and blurred (brightness 2 · blur 8px), clears over 3s ease and settles to 1× over 4.5s cubic-bezier(0,.55,.45,1). The outgoing photo blurs again over 3s and grows to 1.2× over 6s, so they swap like fog lifting. The panel pauses when it leaves the screen and, on return, advances after half a beat (2.5 seconds).

options.every: Beat for advancing to the next slide (s), default 5
options.--fx-fade: Duration of fading in and out (css), default 3s
options.--fx-out: Length for the fading field to grow back (css), default 6s
options.--fx-zoom: Scale of the blurred section (css), default 1.2
options.--fx-blur: Blur of the blurred section (css), default 8px
options.--fx-bright: Brightness of the smudged section (css), default 2
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Photo panel to overlay (direct child of the panel)

from.where: index.html .ix-msg__large·.ix-msg__small (four photos inside two tilted ellipse masks — original jsAutoFadeSlide interval 5000 · item-defog 3s ease filter·opacity, 4.5s cubic-bezier(0,.55,.45,1) transform, 6s ease when fading out) · about.html .ab-vision__slide1·2 (two square cells with the same values)

note: The oval mask lives outside the part — the consumer applies clip-path on the panel (the site uses an objectBoundingBox oval clipPath)
